title: I just released my co-op horror-comedy where giant worms eat your friends
author: enlxxx
selftext:
Hey! I just released my first proper Roblox game: Survive the Worms 🪱

Giant worms live under the ground, your team has to steal their eggs, and everyone ends up as worm food at some point.

\- Grabbed by a worm? You ragdoll and have to hit a timing light on GREEN to break free, or it drags you to its cave  
\- Friends can save you by whacking the worm with a shovel at the last second  
\- Swallowed? Climb out of the stomach before the acid rises, then a worm spits you back out  
\- In the desert, giant leviathans hunt anyone who walks past the totem line  
\- WORMQUAKE: destroyer worms plough through a town, a Titan rises twice per round, a tunneler throws people into the air, and the gas station explodes. Everything breaks and the town rebuilds every round

4 modes, 3 maps, up to 20 players. It's best with friends.

Play it here: https://www.roblox.com/games/71652258951538

The game has 5 bots inside each server so it would be more fun 

It's brand new, so any feedback (bugs, balance, what's fun and what isn't) would help a lot. Thanks! 🙏
